jobs.title: Gas Scheduling Manager
jobs.description_text:
This position will lead a team of pipeline schedulers and ensure alignment of nominations and physical flow across WhiteWater natural gas pipelines and natural gas storage facility. The Manager will oversee the group’s daily scheduling activities as well as train, mentor, and backfill scheduling positions as needed.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Lead a team of gas schedulers, ensuring consistent expectations, processes, and policies across the team, providing suggestions and expertise to commercial and operations on optimization opportunities, and supporting the team in decision making on non-routine items.
  • Monitor and coach employee performance as well as train new hires. Complete performance evaluations for each team member.
  • Ensure optimal customer service with counterparties as well as Gas Control, field operations, measurement, accounting, and commercial staff.
  • Establish and maintain positive relationships with producers, marketers, pipelines, shippers, and various other industry partners.
  • Review the daily gas nominations and evaluate the reasonableness of nominations by shippers based on current and historical trends, communicating directly with shippers as necessary.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to decide how to manage gas nominations in the event of constrained assets while balancing contractual, physical, and financial considerations as well as customer impact of nomination cuts.

jobs.description_text:
Job Description:

The pipeline controller position is in Brookshire, Texas. Newly hired employees will receive on the job training including safety procedures, regulatory requirements, and other procedures related to the pipeline industry. This will be a 12-hour rotating shift schedule that will include nights, weekends and holidays.

Job Responsibilities:

The Pipeline Controller will be responsible for the safe and efficient remote operation of the WhiteWater pipeline systems in compliance with the DOT and state regulatory agencies. Additional controller responsibilities include but not limited to:

  • Remote starting/ stopping pumps/compressors and operating valves.

  • Determining accurate time of pipeline events (deliveries, noms, batches, etc.)
  • Ability to quickly detect abnormal operations and use critical judgement to react accordingly.
  • Monitor pipeline integrity and coordinate with field personnel all maintenance activities.
  • Communicating with field personnel, scheduling groups, customers and suppliers to maximize efficiency, safety, quality and customer service.

jobs.title: Capital Projects Analyst
jobs.description_text:
Vulcan Elements is manufacturing American rare-earth permanent magnets for a secure, resilient future. With a focus on national security and economic resiliency, we serve critical industries such as defense, aerospace, and automotive powering a high-technology future. Vulcan Elements is building a team of ambitious professionals committed to Mission Focus, Technical Excellence and Integrity. 

The Capital Projects Analyst will sit at the intersection of Accounting, Finance and Commercial Manufacturing stewarding the financial aspects of the build-out of Vulcan’s commercial manufacturing facility in Benson, NC, the production equipment that will operate at the facility, and all of the supporting capital infrastructure. This position is a critical part of Vulcan’s success as it will be in charge of Vulcan’s largest financial account: Property, Plant and Equipment.

The ideal candidate combines strong accounting foundations, with an analytical mindset, and an ability to act as the Accounting and Finance liaison to the Commercial Manufacturing team. You will own the processes, controls, and financial infrastructure required to manage a substantial capital project—from construction-in-progress and capitalization through asset commissioning and ongoing fixed-asset accounting.

jobs.description_text:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.  

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.  

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda

At Zone 5 Technologies, we're redefining what's possible in precision weapons and unmanned aircraft systems (UAS). Our team of engineers and innovators are developing cutting-edge autonomous solutions to deliver affordable and scalable precision weapons, interceptors, and UAS.

Zone 5 maintains a weekly flight test cadence at test ranges local to the San Luis Obispo, CA area. Flight maintenance requires significant time spent outdoors in various weather conditions.

    Prepare and transport test equipment, spares, and tools required for flight test operations, both on-site and at remote locations.

We're building the next generation of munitions and unmanned systems for the United States and its allies. If you're driven by hard problems, energized by rapid innovation, and ready to make an impact on defense technology, you belong here.

Role Summary

jobs.title: Senior Proposal Writer
jobs.location_raw: United States · San Luis Obispo, California
jobs.description_text:
At Zone 5 Technologies, we're redefining what's possible in precision weapons and unmanned aircraft systems (UAS). Our team of engineers and innovators are developing cutting-edge autonomous solutions to deliver affordable and scalable precision weapons, interceptors, and UAS.

We're building the next generation of munitions and unmanned systems for the United States and its allies. If you're driven by hard problems, energized by rapid innovation, and ready to make an impact on defense technology, you belong here.

We're seeking a Senior Proposal Writer to develop and maintain highly informed and persuasive proposal content in support of competitive bids for our Unpiloted Aerial Systems (UASs) programs. The ideal candidate has a background in aerospace and/or defense proposal creation, and experience translating technical subject matter into compelling, clear, and concise proposal materials. 

You will work closely with Technical Program Managers (TPMs), business development professionals, engineers, contracts, finance, manufacturing, quality, technical writers, and executive leadership to transform technical, management, and operational information into persuasive proposal narratives that align with customer requirements and evaluation criteria.

jobs.title: Account Manager Enterprise Partnerships, Alabama & Mississippi Gulf Coast
jobs.description_text: Healthcare is changing, and local medical practices are caught in the middle. They are trying to shift from a system that rewards the volume of procedures to one that rewards the quality of patient care—but navigating that shift is incredibly tough. That’s where you come in. As our Account Manager, you will be the ultimate strategic partner, business coach, and advocate for the medical practices in your portfolio. You are the day-to-day anchor of these relationships, responsible for diving into the data, identifying performance gaps, and working hand-in-hand with doctors and healthcare executives. By helping them master Value-Based Care (VBC) contracts, you directly drive financial success (shared savings) and, most importantly, measurably better health outcomes for the community. Note on Travel: On-site check-ins are key to this role. You can expect to travel in person approximately once per month to each account for 1-3 days, often as day trips (supporting accounts in Montana and Utah). Exact schedules flex based on client needs, so some months may feel lighter or heavier than others. Location Requirement: This is primarily a remote role, but candidates must live within a reasonable driving distance or have easy regional flight access to accommodate these monthly multi-day on-site account visits. jobs.title: Growth Development Representative
jobs.description_text: The Growth Development Representative (GDR) drives Aledade's cohort-driven 1:many demand motion at the account level for Core accounts. Operating as an embedded member of a regional sales pod, the GDR exercises independent judgment to own account engagement strategy across an assigned book of accounts, execute cohort sales plays in partnership with Marketing and Network Development, and lead buying-group qualification and discovery in support of opportunity creation. The role requires substantive decision-making across account prioritization, outreach strategy, stakeholder mapping, and qualification with limited day-to-day oversight, and serves as Aledade's primary entry point for commercial talent into Network Development, Marketing, and Practice Transformation. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home across US time zones. Wage Range: $24.00 - $28.85 per hour, plus monthly commission and equity Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience.

jobs.title: Learning and Development Specialist, Remote
jobs.description_text: The Specialist, L&D supports the People Team in designing and implementing high-impact learning programs. Under the leadership of an L&D Manager, the Specialist, L&D will partner with leaders, key stakeholders, and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in business units to support the design, development, implementation and management of learning programs that drive employee performance. The Specialist will leverage experience in adult learning principles to create and manage a wide range of learning interventions and support tools including elearning courses, videos, v/ILT training sessions, job aids, and intranet pages. Learning programs will focus on creating scalable and sustainable learning solutions as the company grows, and tie into critical employee processes such as performance reviews, competency frameworks, and more. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the US or be based from Bethesda, MD office

jobs.title: Manager, Customer Engagement (Remote)
jobs.description_text: The Manager, Customer Engagement serves as a central architect for product Go-To-Market (GTM) execution, bridging the gap between technical product development and clinical application to maximize time-to-value. Operating with minimal oversight under the general direction of their leaders, the Manager is responsible for quarterbacking the end-to-end launch lifecycle for assigned product and program portfolios (such as Quality, Affordability, or Care Programs). This role requires a consultative and solution-oriented professional with a deep sense of curiosity to navigate ambiguous environments and make the unknown known. The Manager will actively utilize proprietary AI-driven workflow tools to scale enablement content, resolve complex roadblocks with creativity, and coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure releases are completely field- and practice-ready. Candidates should be comfortable working remotely from anywhere within the US, across all US time zones. Salary Range: $100,000 to $112,000 base + bonus + equity Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience.

jobs.title: Network Development Sales Lead
jobs.description_text: As a Network Development Lead (NDL), you’ll drive Aledade’s growth by recruiting independent primary care practices into value-based care. You’ll be an empathetic, consultative expert who helps physicians understand how Aledade’s expertise, support, and technology can improve patient outcomes and practice sustainability. You’ll own an annual growth target in your core market. You’ll manage the full sales cycle, from prospecting to signed participation agreements. You’ll also partner with field teams and contribute to regional strategy.

jobs.title: Practice Transformation Specialist, Florida Panhandle
jobs.description_text: Join Aledade as a Practice Transformation Specialist (PTS) and personally make an impact on patient care. Practice Transformation Specialists are HQ’s most direct interface with providers and can glean valuable insight into our partner practice’s happiness and needs. A successful PTS is passionate about population health, and highly mission oriented around providing better care to patients while reducing costs. At Aledade, a PTS can impact the health of their community by transforming one practice at a time. Note on Travel: This is a primarily remote role, but on-site check-ins are key. You can expect to travel in-person approximately 1x per month per practice (expected in the Florida panhandle). Exact schedules flex based on practice needs, meaning some months may be lighter or heavier than others.

jobs.title: Program Specialist, CMMI Programs
jobs.description_text: Reporting directly to the Center for Medicare and Medicaid Innovation (CMMI) Program Manager, the Program Specialist will be a pivotal contributor to the operational excellence and strategic growth of our CMMI initiatives. This role is responsible for the intricate management and refinement of core program processes, ensuring seamless execution across all facets of CMMI models (LEAD & REACH). The Specialist will play a key role in analyzing program performance, identifying opportunities for optimization, and collaborating with diverse internal teams to implement innovative solutions that enhance engagement and outcomes within the CMMI model framework. This position is central to translating strategic vision into operational reality, driving the continuous improvement and successful scaling of CMMI models. Candidates should be comfortable working remotely from anywhere within the US, across all US time zones. Salary Range: $80,000—$92,000 base + bonus + equity Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience.

jobs.title: Program Specialist, Growth
jobs.description_text: The Program Specialist, Growth is a key partner in driving operational excellence and providing high-level administrative support within the Growth department. Acting as the central coordinator for department events, team member experience, logistics, and communications, this role is essential to maintaining effective and efficient operations. The Program Specialist provides direct executive support to the SVPs and works closely with the Growth leadership team—including in strong partnership with the Senior Program Managers of Net Dev, Growth Marketing, and Operations—to ensure strategic priorities are executed seamlessly. By fostering collaboration, and proactively advancing key initiatives, the Operations Specialist enhances the effectiveness and cohesion of the Growth department and supports the achievement of departmental objectives.

jobs.title: Regional Medical Director, Arizona and New Mexico
jobs.description_text: The Regional Medical Director is responsible for developing and sustaining relationships and impacting clinical strategies and workflows that promote practice and patient satisfaction and improve value-based healthcare delivery. This role will inflect and implement Aledade’s programs and technologies and learn what really “moves the needle” in terms of delivering quality health outcomes while reducing overall cost for the assigned ACOs. This role requires demonstrated excellence in creating buy-in with internal and external stakeholders to promote and affect change in the way healthcare is delivered.

jobs.title: Regional Sales Execution Specialist, Remote
jobs.location_raw: Los Angeles, CA · Chicago, IL · Atlanta, GA · Charlotte, NC
jobs.description_text: The Regional Sales Execution Specialist (RSES) is a strategic regional operator accountable for understanding the RSDs vision and goals and translating the region’s growth strategy into coordinated, measurable execution. The RSES independently assesses priorities, establishes the regional operating cadence, and converts high-level objectives into weekly seller plans and field actions that increase physician engagement and accelerate growth. Operating as the connective leader across Sales, Field Marketing, Legal, Operations, and participating practices, the RSES designs and drives the execution model that enables sellers to spend more time building physician relationships. This role exercises sound judgment in prioritizing opportunities, identifying execution risks to the RSD and POD, improving processes, and determining the actions required to move prospects and deals forward. The RSES owns regional pipeline execution, high-impact roadshow and event strategy, deal readiness, contracting coordination, post-event conversion, and the performance insights needed to continuously improve regional results. The role serves as the primary regional liaison to Field Marketing and activates relationships with new signers and physician advocates to expand local momentum. jobs.title: Senior Technical Recruiter
jobs.description_text: Mountain View, CA | AI Fund | Full-time AI Fund is a venture studio founded by Dr. Andrew Ng in 2017. We build AI companies from the ground up with corporate partners, investors, and elite founders, backed by a fund from top-tier global corporations and VC firms. Our purpose is to build AI companies that move humanity forward. Our Engineer in Residence (EIR) program puts a hands-on GenAI builder on an idea for 12 weeks to test it with real users. The strongest go on to found the company, and that is the only way AI Fund deploys capital: every company we fund starts with an EIR hire. The person in this role will own full-cycle recruiting for EIRs and for AI Fund's own team, from first conversation to signed offer. We're rethinking how recruiting works now that AI exists. We're after 5x improvements, not 5% gains, and the recruiter in this seat helps build that. Base salary, plus carry, plus benefits.

The ideal candidate will possess strong communication and organizational skills. They will need a strong technical understanding of our products’ current capabilities and the drive to find out more about our customers’ needs to ensure that our solutions are meeting their expectations to the fullest. Maintenance Engineers and boiler operators start up, regulate, repair, and shut down equipment. They monitor meters, gauges, and computerized controls to ensure that equipment operates safely and within established limits. They use sophisticated electrical and electronic test equipment to service, troubleshoot, repair, and monitor heating, cooling, and ventilation systems. Stationary engineers and boiler operators also perform routine maintenance. They may completely overhaul or replace defective valves, gaskets, or bearings. In addition, they lubricate moving parts, replace filters, and remove soot and corrosion that can make a boiler less efficient. AUTOMATION & CONTROLS SPECIALIST, ASSEMBLY MANUFACTURING (STARLINK)

SpaceX is developing a low latency, broadband internet system to meet the needs of consumers across the globe. Enabled by a constellation of low Earth orbit satellites, Starlink will provide fast, reliable internet to populations with little or no connectivity, including those in rural communities and places where existing services are too expensive or unreliable. The Automation & Controls Specialist will be responsible for building, installing, and commissioning new automation assets, panel builds, and electromechanical controls systems. PROCESS OPERATOR SPECIALIST, AIR SEPARATION UNIT (STARSHIP) - LEVEL 4/5 - NIGHT SHIFT

SpaceX is building its first production-scale Air Separation Unit (ASU) at Starbase to produce the high-purity liquid oxygen that powers Starship. This is not just another industrial plant—it is the critical on-site propellant factory that eliminates supply risk for the most ambitious launch vehicle ever built and lays the operational foundation for producing propellants on the Moon and Mars.

As a process operator specialist on the ASU team, you will operate and support cryogenic distillation, turboexpanders, centrifugal compressors, molecular sieve systems, and high-purity LOX production. You will monitor process parameters, execute approved procedures, complete thorough field rounds, and qualify toward independent watch standing. If you thrive in high-stakes cryogenic environments, want to learn these systems from first principles, and want ownership of mission-critical hardware as you grow, this is the role for you.
